milestone.title: M104/M106 code review follow-ups — C-1, C-2, C-3, C-5

intent.outcome: After this milestone lands, the four non-blocking code-review findings from M104/M106 (CODE-REVIEW-M104-M106.md, C-1..C-9) are addressed: try_wait and pipe.read errors are distinguished by io::ErrorKind (so ECHILD / EINTR / EAGAIN surface distinctly instead of as opaque stringified notes); the bounded_join 'accepted thread leak' surface-doc has an AGENTS.md cross-reference; effective_spec_status's legacy-field-authority asymmetry has an in-source doc note; and ac_verify_shapes's golden-test auto-write path has a 'MUST NOT set AC_VERIFY_SHAPES_UPDATE_GOLDEN' warning for CI.

problem.description: The CODE-REVIEW-M104-M106.md fresh re-read surfaced four actionable follow-ups (C-1..C-5) ranging from a real-but-minor error-handling robustness fix (C-1) to three doc-only cross-reference improvements (C-2, C-3, C-5). C-4 (historical mem::forget) was already superseded by M107. C-6 (store.rs duplicate parse) was already retroactively fixed by M104 self-review commit 7886041 in this branch — verified `paths::compare_milestone_paths` is now used at both call sites. C-7 is informational (no fix needed). C-8 and C-9 are confirmations of working layered fixes.

in_scope: C-1: try_wait and pipe.read distinguish io::ErrorKind (Interrupted retries; other kinds surface a precise error string). Add a unit test in crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs that simulates a try_wait ECHILD.
C-2: master-plan/AGENTS.md gains a 1-sentence cross-reference to the bounded_join 'accepted thread leak' source-doc in crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs:441, so future agents can find it.

C-3: crates/mp/src/validate/plan.rs::effective_spec_status gets a 3-line doc explaining the 'legacy spec_status is authoritative when set; otherwise derive from effective_lifecycle' asymmetry that's consistent with derive_legacy_status_for_w03.
C-5: crates/mp/tests/ac_verify_shapes.rs gains a 'CI MUST NOT set AC_VERIFY_SHAPES_UPDATE_GOLDEN' warning at the top of the test that prevents silent golden drift on CI.
out_of_scope: C-4 historical (M106's mem::forget) — superseded by M107 S3 (already removed from current code).
C-6 store.rs dedup — already addressed in M104 self-review commit 7886041 (`paths::compare_milestone_paths` is now used at both call sites).
C-7 find_mp_from sibling preference — covered by the existing fall-back test, no actionable fix.
C-8 / C-9 — informational confirmations of layered fixes, no action.
Bulk deletion or refactor of the existing test corpus.

design_decisions.choice: Create M109 as a sibling of M108 rather than reopening M104/M106
design_decisions.rationale: Matches the M107 design decision ('Create a single remediation milestone rather than reopening M104/M106. Preserves the historical completion record...'). The fixes are small enough to live in a low-priority greenfield milestone; reopening would break the read-after-write chain and rewrite verified completion records.

C-1..C-5 are direct follow-ups to the code review of M104+M106, which itself was the user-side consequence of the M107 self-review and M108 ER-1..ER-4 fixes. The read-after-write dependency keeps the remediation chain explicit: M107 fixes the gate bug, M108 fixes the doc/regex drift, M109 closes the code-review loop.

design_decisions.choice: C-1 surfaces io::ErrorKind in the execute() error return rather than propagating io::Error across the worker-thread boundary
design_decisions.rationale: The verifier worker thread spawns an mpsc::sync_channel sender, and cross-thread io::Error conversion would require a boxed error or anyhow::Error. A precise string (formatting kind + Display) gives the agent the right information without changing the Result type. Tests cover the new error paths explicitly via a unit test that simulates ECHILD.

design_decisions.choice: C-2 cites the source-doc location rather than restating the rationale
design_decisions.rationale: The bounded_join doc is comprehensive; AGENTS.md should be a pointer, not a duplicate. Single sentence + line reference: 'On verifier global-deadline timeout, a bounded-join mem::forget-ed drain thread is gone with the orchestrator's process — see crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs `bounded_join` for the trade-off matrix.'

design_decisions.choice: C-5 marks AC_VERIFY_SHAPES_UPDATE_GOLDEN as an explicit CI-forbidden env var rather than gating it via test::ignore
design_decisions.rationale: The existing env-var guard is sufficient at runtime. The fix is a doc comment marking the env var as 'MUST NOT set in CI' — operations / CI configuration change rather than a code path change. A test::ignore gate would force every CI runner to pass --ignored, which is more friction than the warning earns.
